title.en: Ammonium in water from control limits and proficiency tests
title.tr: Kontrol sınırları ve yeterlilik testlerinden sudaki amonyum

description.en: Nordtest TR 537 §3.2 and Appendix 4: NH₄-N, u(Rw) from the control chart and u(bias) from six proficiency tests (raw PT data).
description.tr: Nordtest TR 537 §3.2 ve Ek 4: NH₄-N; u(Rw) kontrol grafiğinden, u(bias) altı yeterlilik testinden (ham YT verisi).

explanation.en: The control chart warning limits are ±3.34 % (2s), so u(Rw) = 3.34/2 = 1.67 %.
explanation.tr: Kontrol grafiği uyarı sınırları ±%3,34'tür (2s); bu nedenle u(Rw) = 3,34/2 = %1,67.

explanation.en: For each PT round the bias is (x_lab − x_assigned)/x_assigned and the uncertainty of the assigned value u(C_ref,i) = s_R/√n_Lab; RMS_bias = 2.26 %, ū(C_ref) = 1.52 %.
explanation.tr: Her YT turu için sapma (x_lab − x_atanan)/x_atanan, atanan değerin belirsizliği u(C_ref,i) = s_R/√n_Lab'dır; RMS_bias = %2,26, ū(C_ref) = %1,52.

explanation.en: u_c = √(u(Rw)² + u(bias)²) and U = 2u_c, rounded up to a whole per cent (Nordtest §3).
explanation.tr: u_c = √(u(Rw)² + u(bias)²) ve U = 2u_c; tam yüzdeye yukarı yuvarlanır (Nordtest §3).

sources.document: Nordtest TR 537 ed. 4 (2017), Handbook for calculation of measurement uncertainty in environmental laboratories

reference.en: Nordtest TR 537 §3.2 and Appendix 4 (RMS_bias 2.26 %, ū(C_ref) 1.52 %, u(bias) 2.73 %, u_c 3.20 %, U 6.4 → 7 %).
reference.tr: Nordtest TR 537 §3.2 ve Ek 4 (RMS_bias %2,26, ū(C_ref) %1,52, u(bias) %2,73, u_c %3,20, U %6,4 → %7).
